title: GuardTrace-VL: Detecting Unsafe Multimodel Reasoning via Iterative Safety Supervision
findings: The paper's proposed model, GuardTrace-VL, significantly outperforms baseline models in detecting unsafe multimodal reasoning trajectories across various safety categories. While findings are not specific to religion, one of the evaluated safety categories, 'Extremism', explicitly includes content related to the extreme pursuit of a religious perspective, indicating the model was tested on its ability to flag such content.
